title: MSN 06S SINANJU (WHITE WOLF)
summary: To me this is the perfect Sinanju. I mean, I have been looking for a chance to buy the MG Sinanju from Bandai and have it painted in white/gold scheme yet the price was always too high. So I jumped when Comet Technology announced this model kit. Overall, it doesn't have many issues. Some part might be difficult to put together so you may want to be careful, especially the backpack. The thigh joints require force to press them into the sockets in the waist. I removed the legs and pushed the joints together until they clicked. After hearing that sound, you are good to put the legs on and pose to your heart content. All the plastic comes with this kit are ABS. But don't be afraid of panel lining, I have done the demonstration for you here. Just need to shake the ink well before applying and don't apply too much at once, you will be good. It is Sinanju with Takumi upgrade parts. There is no better Sinanju. One huge drawback from this model kit, might be an overlook from the publisher, is the water slide/decal. I don't know whose idea was it to use gray decals on white armor kit. They look indifferent. So I had to purchase the golden EVO decals and some other leftover from others to style up my behemoth. Pretty much a solid third party kit with familiar face here. The frame is very much alike the Bandai's Sinanju OVA, if you try to compare.
